text:
Leah (AE): Hey team — ZenithHealth is asking for a compliance drop to run a 2-week POC. They want SOC 2 artifact excerpts, ISO scope summary, and a signed pen-test attestation before we start. Also asked whether staging will incur Dedicated pricing. Need a one-pager and ETA by EOD.
Priya (Solutions): Thanks — can you confirm which SOC 2 artifacts? Usually they ask for control descriptions, org chart, and the controls matrix (high level). Do they need evidence files (PDFs) or just a summary?
Leah (AE): They asked for "artifacts to validate controls" and a pen-test sign-off. I'll paste their email snippet: "We require SOC 2: control narrative + list of evidence, ISO 27001 scope doc, and a pen-test attestation letter confirming a third-party pentest run in last 12 months."
Alex (Security): Quick note — we have a latest pen-test attestation from Nov 2025 and a SOC 2 Type II report for FY2025. We can provide redacted evidence samples (logs retention policy, access review snapshot, change management ticket example). For POCs we usually provide: control narrative, redacted evidence bundle, and a template pen-test attestation that legal can sign. Timeline: I can assemble the redacted bundle + attestation draft by tomorrow afternoon.
Diego (Infra): On the staging/dedicated question: if they want a dedicated GPU pool (reserved), that's a separate priced contract. For a short 2-week POC we can spin up isolated staging in our shared hosted environment with IP whitelisting and presigned S3 for evidence transfers — no dedicated commit required. There will be incremental usage charges for burst GPUs. Estimated additional cost for a 2-week isolated staging + presigned storage: ~$4k–$6k depending on token volume.
Leah (AE): Can we give a firm number for procurement? They asked whether evidence delivery triggers any extra legal review that would delay start.
Priya (Solutions): For procurement: give them options — (A) Shared-hosted POC (IP-restricted, redacted artifacts) — estimated $4k. (B) Short-term Dedicated (reserved burst capacity) — needs sales/finance quote, ~2–4 weeks to contract. On legal: pen-test attestation signature from our legal/security team usually clears in 2–3 business days if we use standard wording.
Alex (Security): Attestation template (copy):

-----BEGIN SAMPLE ATTESTATION-----
Redwood Inference certifies that a third-party penetration test covering internet-facing inference endpoints was completed on 2025-11-10. Vulnerabilities classified as critical were remediated prior to attestation. Detailed remediation records can be provided under NDA.
Signed: Alex Security, Head of Security (on behalf of Redwood Inference)
-----END SAMPLE ATTESTATION-----

Alex (Security): We should route the signed copy through legal for final sign-off but the content is stable. If ZenithHealth insists on vendor-signed letterhead, legal will need 24–72 hours.
Leah (AE): Great. For the evidence bundle — are there any artifacts we can't share (PII, customer data)? Need to call this out to procurement.
Alex (Security): Yes — we will redact any customer-identifying data. We can instead provide system-level logs, retention policies, MFA config screenshots, and a sample access review ticket (redacted). Also include a network diagram with no customer IPs.
Diego (Infra): For transfer: I'll prepare a presigned S3 path and a short-lived SFTP account if they need scp. Example presigned prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/zenith/pocevidence-1768123456/
Diego (Infra): ops-bot created ticket #POC-1729 for provisioning and evidence drop (ETA 24h).
ops-bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-1729 — assigned to Diego, Alex, and Priya. Estimated SLA: 24h for provisioning, 48h for full evidence bundle.
Leah (AE): Ok team — deliverables for EOD tomorrow: 1) 1-page compliance summary for procurement, 2) redacted evidence bundle (zip), 3) pen-test attestation draft. Priya, Alex, Diego — can you confirm?
Priya (Solutions): Confirmed. I'll draft the 1-pager and attach the controls matrix excerpt.
Alex (Security): Confirmed — draft attestation + evidence list by EOD tomorrow.
Diego (Infra): Confirmed — presigned S3 + staging IPs and cost estimate to Leah by EOD.
Leah (AE): Thanks — I'll forward to ZenithHealth and ask them to sign NDA if they want detailed remediation records. Will update thread after their response. :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions): Suggestion: include a short note in the 1-pager about optional options for Dedicated (pricing ballpark) so procurement sees path to scale.
Leah (AE): Good call. Adding that.
Alex (Security): Anything else on legal wording? If not, I'll loop Legal after our draft.
Leah (AE): Not right now. Closing for action items.
Diego (Infra): Quick FYI — if they require on-prem (air-gapped) evaluation, lead time is 6+ weeks. Mentioned for completeness.
Leah (AE): Noted. Thanks everyone.
Priya (Solutions): :wave:
